about.media1subtitle:
Plan ₿ Network is a joint initiative between Tether, Fulgur Ventures, DécouvreBitcoin, and led by Giacomo Zucco & Rogzy. 

Our mission is to offer worldwide Bitcoin solutions to make bitcoin mass adoption easier, we focus around three major areas:
• Academic resources to spread knowledge
• Community building to stay decentralized
• Start-up support to drive innovation

Our experts and founders’ network share common values that help guide us throughout our journey.
about.media1title: A global ecosystem of builders focus on Bitcoin
about.media2subtitle:
At Plan ₿ Network, we believe Bitcoin can change the world for the better. We are also realists, aware that this transformation will require the collective effort of billions of people over decades. 

Following this vision, we are building a network of partners, builders, communities, and educators who support one another in this common direction
about.media2title: The Plan ₿ Family — a gathering of people working to change the world

ourValues.1subtext: Bitcoin revolution as a whole, from its base layer to various peer-to-peer communications around it
ourValues.2subtext: We aim to promote the free flow of knowledge and to help build more open-source solutions
ourValues.3subtext: We consider privacy to be one of the most fundamental human rights and essential for progress
ourValues.4subtext: Freedom is the foundation of human progress, shaping our work in peer-to-peer technology, ethics, and real-world solutions
ourValues.5subtext: We design tools for massive, permissionless use, enabling resilience and independence from top-down attacks
ourValues.6subtext: We trust in communities—the backbone of Bitcoin—with plebs everywhere carrying the movement into every village and city
ourValues.title: Our values

academy.blockTitle1Subtext: Plan ₿ Academy helps people understand what Bitcoin is, as a money, as a protocol, as a network. Our programs will guide you from the basics to your professionalization into this industry.
academy.blockTitle2Subtext: The Plan ₿ Programs are designed for individuals who want to professionalize their skills or expand their expertise. From coding and security to marketing and operations, we equip future builders and professionals to thrive in the growing Bitcoin ecosystem.
academy.blockTitle3Subtext: Plan ₿ Academy bring years of expertise to offer institution-grade Bitcoin advisory and training. Globally available, our team designs custom tracks for specific audiences such as law, business, computer science, engineering, and economics. We stand ready to seed and scale public programs, university partnerships, and enterprise integration..

salvador.subtitle: El Salvador
salvador.text: The Node Nation initiative is a high-school program deployed since 2023 in El Salvador and co-built between Pupusas G. and Plan B Network. This program aimed to set up a Bitcoin node in school to allow student to master Bitcoin knowledge in a highly engaging way. With the help of 7 local educator, this initiative has already been deployed in more than 30 high schools accross the country.
salvador.title: High-school national program
